nodes.description: A mouse model based on a human SCN1B mutation, showing region-restricted pyramidal neuron hyperexcitability with reduced dendritic arborization and, notably, no change in GABAergic interneuron firing or synaptic properties. Retigabine, which lowers input resistance, protected against thermal seizures.

Knock-in mice carrying the human DEE52 p.R89C variant have spontaneous and hyperthermia-induced generalized seizures with SUDEP, increased cardiomyocyte transient outward potassium current, ventricular fibrosis, and susceptibility to pacing-induced arrhythmia.

Constitutive Scn1b knockout mice have spontaneous generalized seizures from the second postnatal week, are ataxic, show severely altered cerebellar neuronal pathfinding, and die of SUDEP in 100% of cases before weaning.

Topiramate at 5 mg/kg/d was started at seven months alongside the ketogenic diet in a reported case, and myoclonus frequency and intensity decreased. The co-initiation means neither intervention can be credited alone; the dietary arm is curated separately as Ketogenic Diet.
